description: This file defines and exports a list of optional bundled clusters, functions to check cluster inclusion, environment-based build decisions, and whether a specific cluster should be built based on release info and environment variables.

methods.name: isOptionalBundledCluster
methods.description: Checks if a given cluster is part of the optional bundled clusters set.

methods.name: shouldIncludeOptionalBundledClusters
methods.description: Determines if optional bundled clusters should be included based on environment variable.

methods.name: hasReleasedBundledInstall
methods.description: Checks if the package JSON indicates a released bundled install via npmSpec string.

methods.name: shouldBuildBundledCluster
methods.description: Decides whether to build a specific cluster based on release info, environment, and optional parameters.
